hazard.description: Thick fog rolls in to obscure the landscape.
hazard.name: Fog
hazard.routine: (2+ hours) As long as the dense fog persists, visual Perception checks have a –2 circumstance penalty. Fog causes creatures that are further than 15 feet away to be concealed, and it limits maximum visibility to 500 feet.

traits.name: Weather
traits.text: A weather event is a type of hazard that plays out in exploration mode rather than encounter mode.
